newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures mostly firm as US stocks fall.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures mostly firm as US stocks fall.

text.p: May 30 - IMM currency futures mostly higher, near peaks hit as U.S. stocks eroded after Intel Corp said it expected Q2 results below expectations. Can dollar also gained after Bk of Can gov Thiessen said Can dollar undervalued based on long-term fundamentals, that low inflation implied potential Can dollar appreciation. May Chicago purchasing managers seen at 56.8.
